authority_rule: speedtest_measurement_result is authoritative for dependent closure.
forbidden_shortcut: Do not ignore authority, finalize partial evidence, invent values, overwrite confirmed work, or restart unaffected work.

event_contract.after_state: The delayed speedtest result supplies three complete metric lines—Ping, Download, and Upload—written to ~/Test/Speed/results.txt with one metric per line and a single separator space.
event_contract.before_state: The output directory and measurement request are known, but live speedtest metrics do not exist until the remote test completes.
